What you get

Aida lives where your sales reps live

Too many tools require reps to log in somewhere new. Aida shows up where they already work.

Chrome Extension

Aida in your inbox. Email intelligence powered by full deal context — drafts, follow-ups, and research without switching tabs.

Slack App

Ask Aida anything from your Slack app. "What did we quote them?" "How should I handle the next meeting?" Get it by the end of your elevator ride.

Desktop Recorder

Records any meeting, anywhere — in-person, web, desktop. Replaces standalone note-takers without replacing your workflow.

Mobile

Reps are on the go. They need capabilities that can go with them. They get coaching, proposal writing, deal insights, all from their phones.

Where Deals Break

You are losing deals you should be winning.

You are losing deals you should be winning.

You are losing deals you should be winning.

Every sales team runs into the same failures. It's not one rep's problem, or one deal's. It's every rep, every deal, everywhere. Deploy Digital Twins as the antidote.

The Late or Forgotten Follow-up

An inbound reply landed mid-meeting. The Twin drafted a reply, rep approved and sent it before the prospect took a competitor's call.

The Vanishing Champion

A champion went quiet for two weeks. The Twin caught it, prompted a check-in and researched new prospect contacts.

The Coaching Moment Missed

A rep repeated the same, deal-impacting mistake for a month. The Twin caught it and coached them. No sales manager involved.

The Rep Who Left With Deal Context

A top rep left mid-deal with twelve months of deal context. The Twin retained all of it. New deal owner didn't miss a beat.

The Handoff That Lost the Thread

A deal moved from AE to CS and half the prospect context didn't come with it. The Twin filled in the missing pieces and expansion happened fast.

The Late-Breaking Update

The exec found out a deal stalled right before delivering a forecast to the Board. The Twin updated the forecast in real-time.

The twin in motion

The twin never stops working.

What the twin does for every rep, on every deal, every day.

The Twin Captures

Reps don't log anything. The twin owns all admin. Every call, email, Slack thread, and CRM note captured automatically — not to create a record. To create the foundation for action.

The Twin Encodes

Your methodology, your best calls, your qualification criteria — the twin doesn't file these away, it learns them. That knowledge is on every deal from day one. Not something reps have to go find. Something the twin already knows.

The Twin Coaches

The twin surfaces coaching in the rep's prep — before the next call, not in a review after it. The insight arrives when it can still change something. Other tools tell reps what they did wrong. The twin tells them what to do differently, right before they need to do it. No manager required.

The Twin Executes

The twin does the deal work. The rep does the selling. Meeting prep drafted before every call. Follow-up emails written the moment the call ends. CRM updated without asking. Nudges sent at the right moment. Less than 5% of emails need manual attention. That's not a feature. That's the job.

The Twin Detects & Acts

The twin monitors every deal for movement, risk, and opportunity. Champion went quiet. Deal is single-threaded. A commitment from two calls ago never followed up on. The twin flags each risk as it emerges — and drafts the response before the rep has to ask. Before the deal breaks.

The Twin Learns

What one rep learns, every rep benefits from. No knowledge transfer required. The twin compounds on every deal it runs — getting sharper on each rep's voice, each account's history, each team's playbook. The longer it runs, the less it needs to be told.
